name: P-058 exact ARM native offline local-model qualification
summary: Four canonical Node tests passed on a native GCP ARM64 target against the fresh native8 candidate that passed identity and boot checks. The bound packaged Node and unmodified worker ran offline; pinned model assets and compatibility were checked before and after without adding vm-release metadata to the payload. Subsequent OCI inventory rejected a foreign odiff executable, so this evidence establishes model inference only.

assertions.evidence: Dogfood verifies exact model files through the maintained producer verifier; wrong profile, contract/verifier binding, changed bytes and vm-release snapshot mismatch refuse; qualification leaves the payload snapshot absent.
Wrong dimensions, non-finite values and zero vectors refuse.

Gemma returned three finite nonzero 768-dimensional vectors using the bound packaged worker/Node; relevant cosine 0.8006673812849749 exceeds unrelated 0.38190353911260405; pinned assets match before and after.

Harrier returned three finite nonzero 1024-dimensional vectors using the bound packaged worker/Node; relevant cosine 0.6546441842906568 exceeds unrelated 0.3104810936180123; pinned assets match before and after.

disclosures: This is exact extracted ARM native8 payload inference evidence; runtime ARM64 Node24.18.1 uid1001.
Native8 was produced fresh by task0mv1942vc9f8qqe1c64; native7 remains rejected.

Native8 is rejected for full ARM payload acceptance: OCI precheck0mv19zxu113dcnm68zm found an x86-64 odiff executable. This scoped model result remains valid; the packaging defect is owned as EI-25526231122479676.
